# haloe

> haloe is a private hijama, dry cupping, massage and life coaching practice in Manchester, UK, run by Halima Yasmin for women and men. Sessions are at a private room in Milton Hall, 244 Deansgate, Manchester M3 4BQ on Tuesdays, or at the client's home across Greater Manchester on other days. Life coaching is also offered online by video.

## Facts
- Practitioner: Halima Yasmin. Trained on a CMA and IPHM accredited course (Level 5 Diploma in Health and Cupping Therapy, The Suuk Academy). Fully insured.
- Clinic day: Tuesdays at Milton Hall (Remedy Lounge), 244 Deansgate, Manchester M3 4BQ. Lift access. Private treatment room. No travel fee.
- Home visits: Greater Manchester, Monday to Saturday, 10:00 to 20:00. Travel fee is set by distance and shown before booking.
- Treatments: hijama (wet cupping), dry cupping, massage (face, head, back/neck/shoulders, full body), life coaching (in person or online).
- Booking and prices: https://haloe.health/book (paid in full when booking; free reschedule or full refund up to 48 hours before the session).
- Wording: haloe talks about how a session may feel and support general wellbeing. It does not claim to treat, cure or manage any medical condition.
- Instagram, TikTok and YouTube: @haloe.health
- Contact: halima@haloe.health, WhatsApp +44 7474 833643
